description: Crews v1.8.0 — body-canonical enforcement for review-surfacing kind tags. Adds a Stop-hook hard-block when a `<|report kind=done|question|blocked|>` tag has a long `summary` attribute and a short prose body, plus SessionStart briefing + docs/protocol.md clarifying the rule. Progress kind unconditionally exempt; `stop_hook_active=true` is a retry safety-valve.

userStories.title: Wire the body-canonical gate into hooks/stop.js
userStories.description: As a crews-plugin maintainer, I want the Stop hook to hard-block lazy-summary envelopes for review-surfacing kinds with a retry safety-valve.
acceptanceCriteria: hooks/stop.js requires { detectLazySummary, BODY_CANONICAL_KINDS, DEFAULT_BODY_CANONICAL_THRESHOLDS } directly from ./protocol/report-tags.
Gate placed AFTER parseTurnTags(), AFTER the missing-kind block, AFTER the consumed-inbox eval, and BEFORE decideStopBlock() (the listener-arm gate).

Env vars honored: CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL (set to 'off' to disable entirely), CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL_SUMMARY_CAP (integer override), CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL_BODY_FLOOR (integer override). Invalid env values fall back to defaults.

On detection AND data.stop_hook_active !== true: call bumpBlockCount(state.name, crew, cwd, state.role, 'body not canonical'); call appendLog with a line containing the literal substring 'body-canonical: block'; write { decision: 'block', reason } to stdout; return.
On detection AND data.stop_hook_active === true: call appendLog with a line containing the literal substring 'body-canonical: bypassed-on-retry'; do NOT block; fall through.
Block reason text instructs the member to move substantive content from summary into prose above the tag and includes a brief inline example.
No outbox.jsonl row is written when blocked (verified by reading the file after a blocked fixture).
node tests/run.js stop-decision.test.js still passes (existing listener-arm gate unchanged).
Typecheck passes.
